title: R6H cutset-conditioning exact time-space gate
rigor_tier: bounded exact structural and primitive numeric audit

literature_basis.source: Dechter, Bucket elimination: A unifying framework for reasoning, Artificial Intelligence 113 (1999), DOI 10.1016/S0004-3702(99)00059-4
literature_basis.role: conditioning a cutset and eliminating the residual network is an exact, explicit space-for-time trade; elimination cost is exponential in residual induced width

literature_basis.source: Dechter and El Fattah, Topological parameters for time-space tradeoff, Artificial Intelligence 125 (2001), arXiv:1302.3573
literature_basis.role: hybrid conditioning and tree clustering should be selected against a specified time-space budget from problem structure

program_alignment.central_question: Can the paper-L2 exact likelihood graph cross the 20-variable dense-memory cap by conditioning a small structural cutset, and at what branch-work cost?
program_alignment.epistemic_role: resource prerequisite after R6G found a minimum registered paper-L2 cluster of 36 variables
program_alignment.downstream_gate: do not implement GBP, tensor contraction, correction, or LER sampling until the exact cutset frontier is known

question.H1: an unrestricted cutset reaches residual cluster <=20 with fewer conditioned variables than either class-restricted cutset
question.H2: the relative physical-only and auxiliary-only frontiers identify which variable class carries the induced-width core
question.H3: conditioning lowers the memory exponent but does not necessarily lower the coarse total-work exponent k plus residual cluster size
question.falsification: any primitive conditioned evidence reconstruction differing from the independent 4096-mask evidence by more than 1e-10 rejects the implementation

matrix.selection_rule: prospective and deterministic: recompute global min-fill on the residual graph; choose an eligible variable from its peak cluster, preferring highest original residual degree, latest elimination rank, then lowest id; fall back to the latest eligible eliminated variable
matrix.numeric_gate: for primitive k in {0,2,4}, enumerate every binary cutset assignment, run exact residual bucket elimination with cap 20, sum branch evidence, and compare to the independent exact evidence
matrix.budget: under ten CPU minutes and 2 GiB; zero correction, GBP, tensor, LER, threshold, or performance samples

analysis.branch_logic: run all reversible policies rather than ask a human to rank them; k=0 is a shared control
analysis.interpretation: k+cluster is only a conservative binary-exponent proxy, not measured runtime; widths remain registered-order upper bounds, not optimal treewidth proofs
analysis.stop_rule: report the full exact time-space frontier and route the next method from the observed cap crossing; do not silently broaden into an approximate decoder

acceptance_items.item: prospective R6H contract and literature basis
deterministic cutset frontier and analytic controls

acceptance_items.evidence: 18/18 rows recover independent evidence with maximum relative error 1.780e-15

acceptance_items.item: paper-L2 frontier, report, roadmap, and durable state
acceptance_items.evidence: results/r6h-cutset-conditioning-gate.json and .md; Lab and program artifacts updated

hypothesis_outcomes.H1: rejected for the registered heuristic: auxiliary-only reaches the cap at k=12 on unclustered versus unrestricted k=18, and ties unrestricted k=13 on the superfactor graph
hypothesis_outcomes.H2: supported as a structural diagnostic: auxiliary conditioning is consistently more efficient than physical-only conditioning at lowering the paper-L2 residual cluster
hypothesis_outcomes.H3: supported: the memory cap can be crossed, but the crossing k+cluster proxy remains 32 to 44 and the best registered proxy is 30 at k=4, cluster=26

claim_boundary: R6H is an exact resource audit. It does not claim optimal cutsets, optimal treewidth, approximate-inference accuracy, correction quality, logical performance, thresholds, or fault tolerance.
